personality_one_liner: A clinical, calming, and highly accessible medical interface that guides patients with warmth, clear contrast, and intuitive focus.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room for accessibility. Keep tap targets ≥ 44pt. Avoid dense clustering. Single-column layouts preferred.

do's: Use heavy-tinted blur (minimum 80% opacity) behind the bottom caption/voice bar in the live camera view to ensure text legibility over camera feed.
Use blur on bottom tabs if content scrolls behind.
dont's: Never use blur on primary CTA buttons or list item rows.
Do not use light blurs over the live camera feed; high contrast is strictly required.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A calm, welcoming dashboard to start the daily assessment and view current rehab plan focus.

states.empty: No past assessments yet. Show 'Start Your First Assessment' illustration and prompt.
states.error: Error fetching data. 'Unable to load plan' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Large, fixed primary CTA 'Start Assessment' pinned at the bottom thumb zone. Above it, a hero greeting card with the patient's name and a soft background image overlaid with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Below hero, a 'Today's Plan' summary card.

screens.name: TaskIntro
screens.purpose: Lists the 7 upper-limb movement tasks so the patient knows what to expect before the camera opens.

states.error: Failed to load task list. Retry button.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable list. Each list item has a leading task number (1-7) in a brandTertiary circle, the task title (e.g., 'Seated Forward Reach'), and a chevron. Sticky CTA 'Open Camera & Begin' at bottom.

screens.name: LiveCameraAssessment
screens.purpose: The core live camera view with pose tracking overlays, encouraging voice guidance, and reachable targets.

states.loading: Camera initialization spinner over dark background.
states.error: Camera permission denied or camera failed. Show high-contrast text prompt to enable permissions in settings.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera feed. Top edge: Safe-area inset with 7 progress dots (current task highlighted). Center overlay: Subdued skeleton/pose outline to guide body placement, and a prominent 'brandSecondary' (terracotta) pulsing circular target where the hand must reach. Bottom edge: Sticky, heavily tinted glassmorphism bar (surfaceInverse based) containing the step-by-step text instruction and an animated voice-playing soundwave indicator. No complex menus here.

screens.name: Results
screens.purpose: Displays identified functional issues from the camera assessment without overwhelming the patient.

states.error: Failed to analyze movement. Provide a clear fallback to retake or save raw data.

screens.layout: Summary dashboard layout. Large text for the primary outcome. Uses a sequence of 'surfaceSecondary' cards for each identified issue (e.g., 'Reduced shoulder flexion', 'Trunk compensation'). Each card has a supportive, easy-to-read explanation. Sticky CTA to 'Generate Rehab Plan'.

screens.name: RehabPlan
screens.purpose: A personalized daily exercise plan derived from the assessment results, showing sets, reps, and steps.

states.empty: No active plan. 'Take an assessment to generate your plan.'
states.error: Unable to fetch rehab plan. Retry button.

screens.layout: Generous vertical spacing. Cards are full width minus padding. Each exercise card features a clear, large-font title, a prominent numeric display for sets/reps, and an icon/thumbnail. A sticky bottom CTA allows the user to 'Log Today's Exercises'.

screens.name: ProgressHistory
screens.purpose: Tracks the patient's recovery journey over time with simple visual trends.

states.empty: No history available. 'Complete your first week to see progress.'
states.error: Unable to load history. Retry button.

screens.layout: A large line graph at the top showing range-of-motion or completion score trends. Below the graph, a list of past assessments grouped by month, accessible via standard list rows. Avoid dense data tables.

hero_home.alt: Nurse in blue uniform gently assisting a smiling patient, depicting a warm healthcare environment.

assessment_intro_bg.alt: Clean, calm clinical room background for assessment context.

rehab_plan_cover.alt: Man performing a stretching exercise, representing the daily rehab plan.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow accessibility guidelines: base font size should be at least 18pt for body text to aid stroke survivors with visual deficits. All touch targets must be heavily padded to ≥ 44x44pt.
Implement the 'gradient scrim' pattern strictly for the `hero_home` and any image with overlaid text (transparent to ≥ 70% surfaceInverse).

For the `LiveCameraAssessment` screen, overlay elements must not rely on thin lines. The pose-skeleton should use a thicker stroke (e.g., 3-4px) and the touch target should be a bold, pulsing circle in the `brandSecondary` (terracotta) color so it stands out against any background.

The camera caption/voice bar at the bottom must have a solid or heavily tinted blur background (`surfaceInverse`) to ensure the text instructions and the voice playing indicator are readable regardless of the camera feed beneath it.
Do not use complex navigation (sidebars, multiple tabs) inside the Assessment flow. It must be a linear, one-screen-one-action flow with 'Next' or 'Continue' buttons sticky at the bottom.
Keep language and UI tone clinical but warm. Use `success` and `brandTertiary` to celebrate task completion. Avoid loud alarm colors unless it is a critical error.
Ensure the ElevenLabs voice playback state maps to a clear visual indicator (animated soundwave) in the caption bar so hearing-impaired users know when audio is playing.
